changes.title: Area ambience
items: Every area has its own quiet soundscape: wind gusting down the ravine, frogs and drips in the marshes, old oaks creaking, a low hum among the standing stones, drips in the cave mouth
It stays soft by the party and comes up out in the wild

changes.title: Hanging moss
items: Beards of pale moss and dark vines hang from the trees in the wet, old and tangled woods (the wispy forest, the bog, the ancient wood and others), draped from the crowns, trunks and low branches

changes.title: Wild watch
items: Come down in a wild area and its animals stop, turn to stare at you and back off for a moment before they attack
